summary.text: Ginny Klevorn is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 42B and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists no major-party opponent on the ballot. She first won a House seat in 2018 and co-chairs the State Government Finance and Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ginny Klevorn defeated incumbent Sarah Anderson in the November 6, 2018, general election for Minnesota House District 44A.
She was re-elected to that seat in 2020, then won District 42B in 2022 and 2024.

Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Ethics, House Higher Education Finance and Policy, and Ways and Means committees, plus a co-chair role on the State Government Finance and Policy Committee.
